# Li Lian Properties (https://lilianproperties.com)

> Ng Li Lian (PropNex Realty Pte Ltd, CEA R030769Z) is a Trusted Property Advisor for Singapore's East Coast: District 14 (Geylang, Eunos, Paya Lebar), District 15 (Katong, Marine Parade, Tanjong Rhu) and District 16 (Bedok, Upper East Coast). WhatsApp +65 9852 0128.

## Districts
- [District 14 property: Geylang, Eunos & Paya Lebar](https://lilianproperties.com/district-14-geylang-eunos-paya-lebar): City-fringe homes on three MRT lines: EWL, CCL and DTL.
- [District 15 property: Katong, Marine Parade & Tanjong Rhu](https://lilianproperties.com/district-15-katong-marine-parade): Shophouse heritage, East Coast Park and six TEL stations.
- [District 16 property: Bedok, Upper East Coast & Bayshore](https://lilianproperties.com/district-16-bedok-upper-east-coast): Landed estates, sea air and new TEL stations opening 26 Dec 2026.

## Neighbourhood guides
- [A weekend in Katong & Joo Chiat](https://lilianproperties.com/guides/a-weekend-in-katong): Conserved shophouses, Peranakan heritage, hawker food and the sea, all in District 15.
- [Living near East Coast Park](https://lilianproperties.com/guides/east-coast-park): The seaside park that runs along District 15 and District 16.
- [Bedok: food, parks and getting around](https://lilianproperties.com/guides/bedok-food-and-parks): District 16's town centre, a reservoir park and new TEL stations from 26 Dec 2026.
- [Geylang & Paya Lebar: a food trail and living guide](https://lilianproperties.com/guides/geylang-paya-lebar-food-trail): Markets, hawker food and the Paya Lebar interchange, in District 14.
